name: Maintenance Scheduling Agent
headline: Bring condition, capacity, and readiness evidence into one maintenance decision
pitch: Turn equipment condition, failure-risk, technician capacity, parts readiness, backup capacity, and downtime evidence into review-ready maintenance options without controlling equipment or dispatching work.
why_try: It makes predictive-maintenance AI concrete: maintenance and production leaders can identify the assets needing attention and review crew, parts, backup, and production-impact considerations together.
customer_challenge: A manufacturer reviews condition signals, maintenance history, technician capacity, parts readiness, backup equipment, and production constraints in separate systems. Manual coordination slows planning and can imply assignments or dispatch before authorized review.
microsoft_ai_story: Microsoft Copilot Studio provides the governed conversational experience. Azure IoT Hub contributes approved condition signals, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and Field Service contribute asset, parts, and work context, Power BI presents risk and downtime views, and Microsoft Teams supports planner and production approvals.
business_value: Improves visibility into equipment condition and the operational context surrounding maintenance risk.
Accelerates coordinated review of maintenance windows, technician candidates, parts, and backup capacity.
Protects operational control by keeping equipment commands, work creation, assignment, scheduling, and dispatch in approved systems.
business_flow: Maintenance managers, production supervisors, and operations leaders
Azure IoT Hub and approved condition monitoring
Dynamics 365 asset, parts, and work management

capabilities.name: Maintenance and resource overview
capabilities.purpose: Summarizes equipment status, risk, maintenance history, and technician capacity for planning review.

capabilities.name: Predictive condition alerts
capabilities.purpose: Ranks synthetic sensor and failure-risk evidence while requiring validation in approved condition-monitoring systems.

capabilities.name: Proposed maintenance work planning
capabilities.purpose: Frames maintenance candidates, technician candidates, parts checks, and backup checks without creating, assigning, scheduling, or dispatching work.

capabilities.name: Downtime and preventive trade-off analysis
capabilities.purpose: Compares synthetic exposure and preventive estimates without promising avoided downtime, savings, or production outcomes.

prompts.label: Review equipment and technician capacity
prompts.prompt: Give me the equipment and technician-capacity picture I should review before the weekly maintenance meeting.

recorded_answer.prompt: Give me the equipment and technician-capacity picture I should review before the weekly maintenance meeting.
recorded_answer.answer:
Here's the picture for your weekly meeting:

**Equipment**
- Line 3: Machine #7 is in **yellow alert** — preventive maintenance required. Machines #5, #6, #8 all running normal.
- Line 2: Machine #9 standby (normal), Machine #12 on **watch/monitor** status — worth a look.
- Line 1 (Machine #3, conveyor) and Chiller #2 all normal.

**Technician Capacity**
- Only **Team B** (Marcus Chen – lead, IM-2000 specialist; Sarah Park – Level 3) is available Saturday.
- Team A (Marcus Rivera) and Team C (Lin Zhao) are **not available** this weekend.

**Takeaway:** Machine #7 is the priority item, and Team B is your only Saturday coverage — worth flagging if more than one job needs attention. Want me to pull the predictive alert details or a proposed work order window for #7?
